paite: Mi'n bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gu in gou hiam zuak taleh; bawngtal khat gun in bawngtal nga, belam khat gun in belam li a adit ding ahi.
heading: Ditkik Nawnna Dante
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

paite: Guta inn luh kimu in, kivua in si taleh, avopa pen sisan suah chi a mohsak theih ahi kei ding.
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

paite: Himahleh atung a ni asuah nung ahihleh sisan suah chi a mohpaih theih ahi ding. Ditna kim apiak ding ahi. Piak ding bangmah aneih keileh, aguktak ziak a amah zuak ding ahi.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

paite: Avan guk akhut a hing a akimuhleh, bawngtal hiam ahihkeileh sabiltung hiam, ahihkeileh belam hiam hitaleh, amun nih apiakkik ding ahi.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

paite: Mi'n lou hiam, grephuan hiam nek a omsak in, aganta lutsak in, midang lou ah va ta taleh; ama lou hoihna pen leh ama grephuan hoihna pen a pan ditna abawl ding ahi.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

paite: Mei hong kang in, ling lak hong kuang in, buh hiam ahihkeileh hai dingh lai hiam ahihkeileh lou kangse taleh; amei khahpa'n ditna abawl ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa kep ding in dangka sum hiam van hiam pekhia henla, huai mi inn a pan kigu taleh; guta akimuhleh azahnih pia hen.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

paite: Guta akimuh keileh, a-invengpa van tung ah akhut akha na hiam, chih theihna ding in vaihawmte kiang ah inn neipa api ding ahi.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

paite: Tatlekna chiteng, bawngtal thu ah hiam, sabiltung thu ah hiam, belam thu ah hiam, puansilh thu ah hiam, van mansak thu ah hiam, midang in kei a ahi, achihleh, alang tuak thu vaihawmte ma atut ding ahi. Vaihawmte mohpaihpa'n a-invengpa aleh nih apiak ding ahi.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa kiang ah akep ding in sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gan himhim hiam pekhia henla; si hiam, liam hiam, hawlmang hiam a om in, kuamah in mu kei taleh;
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

paite: TOUPA kichiamna amau gel kikal ah a-om dia; a-invengpa' van tung ah akhut akha kei chihna; avan neipa'n huai apom dia, adin kei ding hi.
english: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

paite: Amah a pan guk a-omleh, aneipa kiang ah ditna abawl ding hi.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

paite: Gan balnen in ana om taleh, atheihpihna ding in asa hon tawi hen, balnen a om pen adin kei ding hi.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa banghiam khel henla, anei pen om louh kal in liam in hiam si hiam in om taleh, adit ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

paite: Himahleh aneipa akiang a om ahihleh adin kei ding. Van khelh man in adin khin lel hi.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

paite: Khamsa hilou nungak siangthou khat pasal in zol henla, kithuahpih taleh, mou man pia in zi in anei ngeingei ding ahi.
heading: Biakna Leh Gamtatna Dante
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

paite: Anumei pa'n akiang a piak anial bilbelleh, nungak siangthoute man dungzui in sum ape ding hi.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

paite: Dawizawl ahin na phal ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

paite: Ganta kithuahpih peuhmah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

paite: TOUPA kiang kia lou ngal, pathian himhim kiang a kithoih peuhmah hihsiat dimdem ding ahi.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.

paite: Mikhual na subuai hiam, na nuaisiah hiam ding ahi kei hi; Aigupta gam a mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

paite: Meithai hiam, pa nei lou naupang hiam na hihgenthei ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

paite: Bangchiteng a amau na gentheihsak a, ka kiang a ahong kah peuhmah uleh, akahna uh ka ngaikhe ngeingei ding hi.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

paite: Ka thangpaihna asou dia, namsau in ka hon that ding hi. Na zite uh meithai ahi ding ua, na tate uh pa nei lou ahi ding uhi.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

paite: Na kiang ua om ka mite lak a mizawng kuapeuh kiang a sum na leitawi sakleh, leitawisakmi hih bang a sumpung na nek louh ding ahi.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

paite: Kichiamna a na inveng puansilh na lakleh, ni tum ma a ama kiang a na va piakkik ding ahi.
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

paite: Huai lah akikhuhna neihsun ahi ngal a, avun a ding a apuansilh ahi. Bang in a-ihmu dia? Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang a, ahong kah chiang in ka za ding; hehpih thei ka hih ziak in.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

paite: Pathian na enghou ding ahi kei a, na mite vaihawmmi leng na hamsiat ding ahi kei hi.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

paite: Na theigah min masate, na uain masate lan ding in na zekai ding ahi kei. Na tapate lak a piang masapen kei na hon piak ding ahi.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

paite: Huchi mah bang in na bawngtalte lak ah leng na hih ding ahi. Na belamte lak ah leng hiai bang in na hih ding ahi. Ni sagih sung api kiang ah na omsak dia, ani giat ni a kei na hon piak ding ahi.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

paite: Kei a dia misiangthoute na hih ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in gamlak a gamsa nek bang sa himhim na nek louh ding uh ahi a; uite na pe zaw ding uhi.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
